description: This file contains the main Flutter application code for a Tic Tac Toe game, including UI setup, game logic, state management, and styling.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the application theme and home page.

classes.name: TicTacToeHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the game's UI, state, and user interactions.

classes.name: _TicTacToeHomePageState
classes.description: State object handling game logic, rendering, and user input for the Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the main app, including theme, title, and home page.

methods.name: _resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: _handleCellTap
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a board cell to make a move.

methods.name: _updateGameState
methods.description: Checks for a win or draw after a move and updates game status.

methods.name: _statusMessage
methods.description: Provides the current game status message, such as which player's turn or who won.

methods.name: _statusColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status message based on game state.

methods.name: _buildCell
methods.description: Builds a widget for an individual game cell, handling display and tap interactions.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Checks whether a specific cell is part of the winning line.
